column1: # Español (es) interface catalog for Local App.
# Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> English source text <TAB> translation
#   context  usually empty. `@plural`, `@id` and `@msg` mean something to the apps; any other
#            word is a label that tells apart two meanings of the same English.
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns (in any
#            order), and a trailing "." in one needs one in the other.
#   @plural  English `one|other`; the translation lists this language's plural forms, `|`-separated.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No other product's localisation or translated UI was consulted; write new

column2: This is the Local suite's desktop template: a window, a menu bar, an About window with an update check, translated interface, native file pickers and the craft-fonts faces. Replace this page with your app.
column3: Esta es la plantilla de app de escritorio de la suite Local: una ventana, una barra de menús, una ventana Acerca de con comprobación de actualizaciones, interfaz traducida, selectores nativos de archivo y las fuentes de craft-fonts. Sustituye esta página por tu app.
